newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy says protection need for Zaire aid.
newsitem.headline: Italy says protection need for Zaire aid.

text.p: Italy said on Saturday that "suitable measures of protection" were needed so that the United Nations could aid refugees in eastern Zaire.

Most aid agencies have pulled out of chaotic east Zaire, where they were helping about a million Rwandan Hutu refugees. Fighting between the Zairean army and ethnic Tutsi rebels has led to border clashes in which the Tutsi-led Rwandan army has captured several Zairean towns.

"In light of the worsening situation of the refugees in the region of Kivu, on the border between Rwanda and Zaire, Italy asks the United Nations to urgently organise an intervention of humanitarian aid, with the suitable measures of protection, to which Italy, also within the European Union, is ready to give its support," the Foreign Ministry said in a statement.
